meta.title: Request a quote | Mcars
meta.description: Request your car transport price with no obligation. You will receive a personal reply within 24 hours with a price and schedule — no calculator, no automatic email.

hero.title: Car transport quote
hero.lead: Fill in the form below and quickly receive a no-obligation quote for transporting your vehicle.

form.title: Plan your transport. <muted>In four short steps.</muted>
form.intro: Departure, destination, your car and your details — we will send you a personal price and schedule within 24 hours.

factors.label: What determines the price?
factors.intro: We don’t charge fixed rates. We put your price together manually based on these factors — so it is right for your specific transport.

items.title: Distance
items.body: The further the trip, the more kilometres and time. The distance between the collection and delivery address helps determine the price.

items.title: Type of vehicle
items.body: Dimensions and weight play a role. A compact car loads differently from a van, SUV or classic car.

items.title: Running or non-running
items.body: Does the car drive, can it roll or is it completely locked? For non-running cars we provide a winch or forklift.

items.title: Extras on board
items.body: A roof box, bike rack or belongings in the car? Let us know — it affects how we load and plan.

items.title: Urgent or normal scheduling
items.body: Does your trip fit our existing routes, or is it urgent? The scheduling counts towards the price.

items.title: Country of collection/delivery
items.body: Within Belgium or far into Europe: the country of collection and delivery helps determine the route and the cost.

reassurance.title: Reply within 24 hours
reassurance.body: You quickly get a price and a possible schedule back — no waiting for days.

reassurance.title: Personal, not a calculator
reassurance.body: Every quote is drawn up manually by our team, tailored to your situation.

reassurance.title: We reply ourselves
reassurance.body: No automatic confirmation email. You hear directly from a real person at Mcars.

faq.title: About your quote. <muted>Briefly explained.</muted>
faq.phone: Not sure what details you need? Call <link>{phone}</link> — we will gladly help you personally.

items.q: How quickly will I get a reply to my request?
items.a: You will receive a personal reply within 24 hours with the price and the possible schedule. Every request is looked at manually — so you will not receive an automatic confirmation email, we reply ourselves.

items.q: What details do I need to request a quote?
items.a: Handy to have at hand: whether you are a private customer or a business, the collection and delivery address (or our depot), the vehicle and its condition (starts and drives, can roll or locked, with or without a roof box), and the desired date. The more complete your request, the more accurately we can determine your price.

items.q: Can I have it delivered to or collected from our depot?
items.a: Yes. Delivery or collection at our depot in Roeselare is possible and is generally cheaper than at home. Mention it in your request and we will take it into account.
Private customers pay before collection. Businesses simply pay by invoice. We agree the practical arrangements with you beforehand.
